title: Sealed watch access (plaintext)
description: What watch_access.sealed carries once the watch opened it. config is the watch's own client_config (with its HA token; null only while it has none, e.g. outside its access hours: the watch then keeps its stored token and applies the rest). The watch checks that client_id equals the outer client_id and its own, and ignores an issued_at older than the access it holds (a replayed message never replaces a newer one).

issued_at.description: When the hub sealed it (UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds).
